description: Facial recognition in schools is now documented in a new Privacy International map that logs named schools, vendors, bans and fines. Karnataka, India, has ordered face-scan attendance for government and aided schools in 2026-27, officials link attendance data to meal-scheme counts, and critics warn
body_lead: Karnataka, the Indian state, has ordered AI face-scan attendance for government and aided schools starting in the 2026-27 school year, according to Careers360's June report. A new global map from Privacy International (PI) shows how often such systems are bought, mandated or quietly installed before families get a say. The London-based digital rights charity's explainer, dated Monday, Nov. 9, logs named schools, vendors, incidents and regulatory actions, and says no systematic global record of the technology's spread into classrooms existed before it.
